ja: か つ て 、 戦 争 が あ っ た ―
旧 地 球 連 邦 軍 主 力 Ｍ Ｓ ド ー ト レ ス 起 動 ！
『機動新世紀ガンダムX』に登場する、旧地球連邦軍などで運用される汎用量産型ＭＳ「ドートレス」がＨＧキットで商品化。
特徴的な頭部や胴体、脚部、武装等を新規造形パーツで再現し、印象的な機体カラーを成形色で再現。
●　新規造形パーツを交えドートレスのスタイリングを再現
頭部、胴体、脚部に新規パーツを使用し、量産型ＭＳ「ドートレス」の機体フォルムを設定イメージにこだわり立体化。
ライトグリーン、オレンジを主体とする機体カラーリングを成形色で再現。
●　武装類を新規造形で再現！
９０ｍｍマシンガン、シールドを新規造形で再現。
●　組み立てやすさ＆ポージングの自由度を関節構造により両立！
部隊編成など量産型MSの魅力あふれる集団バトルイメージを演出可能。

en: Once upon a time, there was a war.
The main force of the former Earth Federation army, MS Dortres, is activated!
The general-purpose mass-produced MS "Dotless", which appears in "Mobile New Century GundamX" and is used by the former Earth Federation forces, has been commercialized with HGKit.
The characteristic head, torso, legs, weapons, etc. are reproduced with new molded parts, and the impressive aircraft color is reproduced with molded colors.
● Reproduce the Dotress styling with new modeling parts
Using new parts for the head, torso, and legs, the body form of the mass-produced MS "Dortress" has been made into a three-dimensional model that adheres to the set image.
The aircraft coloring, which is mainly light green and orange, is reproduced with molded colors.
● Weapons are reproduced with new modeling!
90mm machine gun, Seal is reproduced with new modeling.
● Ease of assembly and freedom of posing are achieved by the joint structure!
It is possible to create a group battle image full of the charm of mass-produced MS, such as troop formations.
Attached weapons: 90mm machine gun / Seal
1/144 Scale Assembly plastic model
Target age: 8 years old and above
Product material: PS/PE
・No adhesive is used for assembly
